case.text: vi er fire konsulenter som fakturerer rundt 200 timer i måneden totalt - hvilket faktureringssystem bør vi velge?

answer:
For dere som er fire konsulenter med rundt 200 fakturerte timer i måneden, er **Fiken** det beste valget. Det er skreddersydd for små norske bedrifter, støtter timesfakturering, EHF, bankintegrasjon, automatisk mva-rapportering til Altinn, og har en enkel, intuitiv brukerflate. Prisen for grunnpakken er **149 kroner i måneden** (per bedrift, ikke per bruker), og den inkluderer både fakturering og regnskap. Dere får også gratis support fra ekte mennesker, ikke chatboter.

**Beslutningsregel som snur valget:**
Hvis dere trenger avansert prosjektstyring, tidssporing eller har flere ansatte, kan Tripletex være bedre – men det koster fra 399 kroner i måneden. For dere som først og fremst trenger effektiv fakturering og regnskap, er Fiken mer enn godt nok.

Hva du bør se etter i faktureringsprogramvare
Norwegian invoicing software needs to meet specific legal requirements. At a minimum, your tool should generate invoices that comply with the Bookkeeping Act (Bokforingsloven), including sequential invoice numbers, correct VAT calculations, and proper seller and buyer information. Beyond compliance, you want a tool that is easy to use, affordable, and fits your workflow.
Key features to consider include EHF support (electronic invoicing for public sector clients), integration with your bank, automatic VAT reporting, and the ability to send reminders for overdue payments. If you work with international clients, multi-currency support is also valuable.
Fiken is one of Norway's most popular accounting and invoicing tools, especially among sole proprietors (ENK) and small businesses (AS). It offers a comprehensive accounting system alongside invoicing, which makes it a good fit if you need full bookkeeping capabilities.
Fiken supports EHF invoicing, bank integration, and automatic VAT reporting to Altinn. The interface is clean and well-designed. Pricing starts at around 149 NOK per month for the basic plan, making it affordable for most freelancers. However, Fiken requires you to have your own registered company to use it.
Tripletex is a more feature-rich platform aimed at small to medium businesses. It includes invoicing, project management, time tracking, and full accounting. Tripletex is a strong choice if you have employees or manage multiple projects.
